brief:
A conservative online personality wore a black veil and entered a Minneapolis polling station during Minnesota's August primary, accompanied by another man in traditional Muslim clothing who spoke in an exaggerated accent, according to Dawn. A hidden camera recorded the encounter. The veiled man was identified as Cam Higby, a conservative online personality.

The incident occurred as Arab and Muslim voters have increasingly mobilized against far-right political candidates and policies. The encounter highlights tensions between conservative activists and Muslim communities during the election cycle.
dek: On Minnesota’s primary day in August, a man in a black veil entered a Minneapolis polling station accompanied by another wearing traditional Muslim clothing and speaking in an exaggerated accent. A hidden camera recorded the encounter. The veiled man was Cam Higby, a conservative online personality.
title: Conservative activist poses as Muslim voter at Minnesota polling station
